You will define how a system is structured across embedded and edge compute, the robotics middleware and autonomy stack, connectivity, and the cloud and data platform that supports a deployed fleet. Across our programs you will encounter classical automation and scripted behaviors, purpose-trained models, and learned policies, and part of this role is guiding clients toward the approach best suited to their requirements. Support the project estimation team in evaluating new opportunities and providing technical and timeline input. Experience with connected device and fleet architecture, covering OTA update mechanisms, telemetry pipelines, and remote diagnostics. Proficiency with modern software delivery practices, including Git workflows, containerization, CI/CD, and automated testing. Experience with system architecture, integration, and validation across hardware and software boundaries. Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to interface with clients effectively and explain technical tradeoffs to business stakeholders. Experience with cloud platforms and IoT services, including MQTT and device management at fleet scale. Experience with edge compute platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson, and the tradeoffs of deploying software to constrained hardware. Experience building and operating systems that remain serviceable and supportable years after deployment. Experience leading or mentoring engineering teams in a professional or consulting context.
